Summary: S01 Scenario: to browse the scenario list with filters
Description: As a reader, I want to browse the scenario list with filters, so that I can find a scenario by id, title, priority, evidence tier, layer, status, coverage or testability.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given filters, when combined, then they apply with AND and the count reads n of total
Given no match, when the list renders, then it reads 'No scenario matches these filters.'
Given a card, when it renders, then it shows id, priority, evidence tier, title, verdict bar, layer, step count and Have share or 'not scored'

Summary: S02 Scenario: to read a scenario end to end
Description: As a reader, I want to read a scenario end to end, so that I understand what happens, what we would see, and what we would not.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given scenario 021, when the record renders, then every section in screens/scenario.md section 4 is present with the example values
Given scaled_up, when it renders, then it is prefixed 'Hypothetical, not observed.'
Given mapping_confidence editorial, when the mapping renders, then the caveat box with the notes is shown

Summary: S03 Scenario: to see each evidence row's verdict with its scores
Description: As a reader, I want to see each evidence row's verdict with its scores, so that I can tell Have from Collectable from Blind from Unscored at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a row with no scores, when it renders, then it reads Unscored and 'not scored'
Given any verdict chip, when it renders, then the word is next to the color
Given a row with visibility 0, when it renders, then the chip reads Blind

Summary: S04 Every screen: to always see the organization, the shape and whether drafts are included
Description: As a reader, I want to always see the organization, the shape and whether drafts are included, so that I never act on a figure that is not what I think it is.
Acceptance Criteria: Given any screen with a figure, when it renders, then organization, shape and drafts flag are in the header

Summary: S05 Coverage: to see coverage per scenario and in aggregate with completeness beside every figure
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to see coverage per scenario and in aggregate with completeness beside every figure, so that I know what is measured and what is not.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an unscored scenario, when the list renders, then its share reads n/a and it is absent from the mean
Given any percentage, when it renders, then scored of rows is beside it
Given mean_have null, when the tile renders, then it reads 'nothing scored yet'

Summary: S06 Coverage: to see which NOW scenarios have a Blind step and which gaps have no owner
Description: As a risk reader, I want to see which NOW scenarios have a Blind step and which gaps have no owner, so that I know the exposure and the escalation list.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given metrics.exposed, when the panel renders, then the scenario and its blind steps are listed
Given no exposed scenario, when it renders, then the empty state text is shown

Summary: S07 Use cases: to read a use case with its status, autonomy and limits visible
Description: As a reader, I want to read a use case with its status, autonomy and limits visible, so that I do not over trust a plan or an automation.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given any use case, when it renders, then status, autonomy and limits are visible
Given autonomy above notify, when it renders, then the promotion section is shown
Given an illustrative record, when it renders, then the banner is shown

Summary: S08 Frameworks: to see every identifier the library uses, its baseline, and which scenarios use it
Description: As an analyst, I want to see every identifier the library uses, its baseline, and which scenarios use it, so that I map to identifiers that exist and see where they are used.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the page, when it renders, then the baseline versions are shown and the reliability note is present
Given a revoked identifier, when it renders, then it is marked and its replacement named

Summary: S09 Documentation: to read the layer cards and the environment shapes from records
Description: As a reader, I want to read the layer cards and the environment shapes from records, so that the page cannot drift from the library.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the AI stack shape, when Environments renders, then five layer cards show its text
Given a layer page, when it renders, then its identifiers and scenarios come from the records
Given a proposed shape, when it renders, then it is marked proposed

Summary: S10 Reports: to see posture, scoreboard and movement from snapshots
Description: As leadership, I want to see posture, scoreboard and movement from snapshots, so that I see where the program stands and whether movement was real.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a snapshot, when posture renders, then organization, shape, baseline and snapshot id are visible
Given rescores in the period, when movement renders, then they are listed separately from improvements
Given no snapshot, when the screen renders, then it says so and shows no figures

Summary: S11 Scenario: to switch a scenario into Edit mode without starting a session
Description: As an analyst, I want to switch a scenario into Edit mode without starting a session, so that I can fix a record at my desk.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a signed in person, when Edit is pressed, then authored and assessment fields become editable
Given Edit mode, when derived fields render, then each is marked derived and has no control
Given Discard with unsaved edits, when pressed, then a confirmation is asked and edits are dropped

Summary: S12 Scenario: to save my edits as one change set with a reason
Description: As an analyst, I want to save my edits as one change set with a reason, so that every change is attributed and validated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Save, when pressed, then the dialog asks for reason and a conditional ticket
Given a refused change set, when the response arrives, then every finding is shown next to its field and edits are kept
Given a successful save, when the response arrives, then the record shown is the server's version

Summary: S13 Scenario: to be stopped from rescoring without a ticket
Description: As an analyst, I want to be stopped from rescoring without a ticket, so that rescores stay visible as rescores.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a changed score on an already scored row and no ticket, when Save is submitted, then the dialog refuses with 'a score change without a ticket is a rescore'

Summary: S14 Scenario: to publish a scenario I did not write
Description: As a reviewer, I want to publish a scenario I did not write, so that the independent review rule holds.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Publish with reviewer equal to author, when submitted, then the server refuses and the message is shown
Given a record with a remaining warning, when Publish is submitted, then it is refused with the warning listed

Summary: S15 Scenario: to see a conflict when the record changed under me
Description: As an analyst, I want to see a conflict when the record changed under me, so that I do not overwrite someone else's work.
Acceptance Criteria: Given a stale base_version, when Save is submitted, then the server refuses, the record reloads, and my edits stay in the cards

Summary: S16 Session: to run a scoring session with my name on everything captured
Description: As a facilitator, I want to run a scoring session with my name on everything captured, so that the room's answers are attributed and read back.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a session, when started, then the facilitator name is required and shown in the bar
Given half a score pair, when a row renders, then it stays Unscored with the picked value shown
Given the readback, when it renders, then every captured change is listed per scenario and step

Summary: S17 Session: to score as a map and in tabletop mode
Description: As a facilitator, I want to score as a map and in tabletop mode, so that a room can follow the questions on a projector.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the map's no path, when taken, then visibility 0 and detection -1 commit together
Given tabletop mode, when active, then arrow keys move focus and Esc exits
Given cards and map, when the same answers are given, then the capture is identical

Summary: S18 Session: to submit the session or export it for later
Description: As a facilitator, I want to submit the session or export it for later, so that a room with no connection still gets its work applied.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Submit, when the server answers, then findings show per scenario and nothing is marked applied until it says so
Given Export, when pressed, then a session file in session_format 1 is produced

Summary: S19 Use cases: to edit a use case and add a new one
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to edit a use case and add a new one, so that use cases move through their phases and statuses.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given autonomy set above notify with no promotion, when saved, then the server refuses
Given covers with a step the scenario lacks, when saved, then the server refuses naming the step
Given Add, when the required fields are filled, then a proposed use case is created with the next id

Summary: S20 Bring in a scenario: to convert a model's answer into a checked draft
Description: As an analyst, I want to convert a model's answer into a checked draft, so that a new scenario lands with its problems flagged, not hidden.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a canonical layer string in a step tag, when checked, then it is shortened and flagged
Given seven steps, when checked, then the extra is dropped loudly and the rest renumbered
Given an unreadable source tier, when checked, then it lands as '2' with a review note

Summary: S21 Scenario management: to see readiness for every scenario with blockers verbatim
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to see readiness for every scenario with blockers verbatim, so that I know what can be tested today and what is missing.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a blocked scenario, when readiness renders, then every blocker string is shown word for word
Given the filter ready, when applied, then only scenarios with no blockers on the scoring path are listed

Summary: S22 Scenario management: to read a run's scorecard
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to read a run's scorecard, so that I know whether the library describes the estate or our optimism.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given RUN-021 examples, when the scorecard renders, then rows, totals, by class and caveats match
Given a scratch pipeline, when it renders, then Have and Collectable rows read unscoreable with the note
Given a triggered stop condition, when it renders, then it reads as a successful guardrail

Summary: S23 Scenario management: to accept or reject a proposed rescore
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to accept or reject a proposed rescore, so that the library learns from runs without anything writing itself back.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given Accept, when submitted, then the change carries the run id as ticket and the row updates only after the server applies it
Given Reject, when submitted, then the proposal is marked rejected with the reason

Summary: S24 Import: to hand over one run document per scenario per run
Description: As the agentic platform, I want to hand over one run document per scenario per run, so that runs land as immutable records.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a valid import, when posted, then one run record is created and nothing else
Given a moved prediction digest, when posted, then it is refused with the digest message
Given an unknown environment, when posted, then it is refused

Summary: S25 Scenario: to set an agent proposed score to human after reviewing the evidence
Description: As a detection engineer, I want to set an agent proposed score to human after reviewing the evidence, so that proposals become measurements only by a person's act.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a row marked agent-proposed, when Edit sets provenance to human-session and saves with a reason, then the row counts in coverage afterwards
Given agent-proposed rows, when Publish is attempted, then it is refused

Summary: S26 Administration: to define an environment and version it
Description: As an administrator, I want to define an environment and version it, so that runs cite an environment that cannot change under them.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given an edit to an environment, when saved, then a new version is created and the old one is unchanged
Given a delete of a cited environment, when attempted, then it is refused

Summary: S27 Administration: to maintain infrastructure shapes
Description: As an administrator, I want to maintain infrastructure shapes, so that the layer cards, seams and categories are records.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the catalog shape, when Edit is on, then its layers have no control
Given a proposed shape, when edited and saved, then it validates against the shape schema

Summary: S28 Administration: to see the baseline's owner and pin status
Description: As an administrator, I want to see the baseline's owner and pin status, so that the first migration can be planned.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given owner UNASSIGNED, when the panel renders, then a warning says the migration cannot happen until someone is named
Given the checksum lock, when the panel renders, then each artifact shows vendored or missing
